limits: Public f_acm.c/u_serial.h are unmodified; explicit guarded controllerBULK12 and the existing DWC bring-up policies remain. Not native controllerINT, sustained/hotplug/installation qualification.

Startup notification is independently required before serialOUT. Real-connect-before-data is separately recorded by the second host-only2s observation; no dependence or precise controller cause follows from first-run timing alone.
Target queued TX receipts alone do not establish host delivery; full serial pass requires all per-end bytes/hashes/modem/notification checks.
FIFO bit15 is asynchronous/periodic classification; no RAM selector, frame counter or precise update mechanism is inferred.
Fixed-port bounded RAM experiments, native120s lease and authenticated physical recovery; no persistent or post-loader software reset.
